_comment: Single source of truth for native deep links (Android App Links + iOS Universal Links). Everything else is derived from or checked against this file: public/.well-known/* (tools/generate-deep-links.mjs), the AndroidManifest intent-filter and the iOS entitlements (both verified by tools/lib/deep-links.test.mjs), and the in-app allow-list (src/app/core/deep-links/deep-link-routes.ts, also verified). See docs/DEEP-LINKS.md.
